description: This file defines the EntityRepositoryInterface, an interface for entity repository operations in Drupal, including methods for loading entities by UUID or config target, retrieving translations, active variants, and canonical variants.

classes.name: EntityRepositoryInterface
classes.description: Interface for entity repository operations in Drupal.

methods.name: loadEntityByUuid
methods.description: Loads an entity by its UUID, may throw EntityStorageException if UUIDs are unsupported for the entity type.

methods.name: loadEntityByConfigTarget
methods.description: Loads an entity by its configuration target identifier, may throw EntityStorageException.

methods.name: getTranslationFromContext
methods.description: Retrieves the translation of an entity based on context and language code.

methods.name: getActive
methods.description: Retrieves the active entity variant based on context.

methods.name: getActiveMultiple
methods.description: Retrieves multiple active entity variants based on context.

methods.name: getCanonical
methods.description: Retrieves the canonical entity variant based on context.

methods.name: getCanonicalMultiple
methods.description: Retrieves multiple canonical entity variants based on context.
